caption:
You keep waiting for the perfect moment — but the flood is already here.

Which one are you right now — waiting for the flood to stop, or learning to swim? Comment it below. That's one god inside you decoded. Vishnu is just the beginning — follow Gods of the Mind and we'll meet every part of you, one at a time, until the whole map is yours.

comment: Vishnu's first form wasn't a warrior or a king — it was a fish in a flood. That quiet adaptability is something we all carry and almost never trust. 🌊 Are you waiting for calm before you start, or have you learned to move through the chaos? Tell me honestly — I read every comment.
